title: Button Bounce Timeline Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Differentiate a raw, bouncing button signal from a properly debounced signal by examining a shared timeline, and identify how the debounce time constant determines which transitions get accepted as a single press.

learningObjectives: Differentiate a raw, bouncing button signal from a properly debounced signal by examining a shared timeline, and identify how the debounce time constant determines which transitions get accepted as a single press.
